## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric ritual manual compiled by **Huìlín** 慧琳 ([慧琳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E7%90%B3), 737–820), the great Tang Buddhist lexicographer and disciple of Amoghavajra. The text covers the twin preparatory rites of **mandala-construction** (*jiànlì màntúluó* 建立曼荼羅) and **site-selection** (*jiǎnzé dìfǎ* 揀擇地法).

**Abstract**

The text is one of the few Esoteric ritual works by Huìlín — better known for his great philological work the *Yīqiè jīng yīnyì* 一切經音義 ([KR6s0013](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0013), T2128). His Esoteric training under Amoghavajra is reflected in this short ritual manual, which combines the *mandala-construction* prescriptions with the *site-selection* prescriptions into a single working manual. The text supplements the more general anonymous *Fàntiān zédì fǎ* ([KR6j0081](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0081)) with a more specifically Esoteric framework drawing on the Amoghavajra tradition.

The composition dates from Huìlín's mature career, conventionally bracketed 770–820 (his death year).
